scripts.test:web:smoke: env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR npm run test:smoke --workspace @jambandnerd/web
scripts.test:web:smoke:hosted: env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR npm run test:smoke:hosted --workspace @jambandnerd/web
scripts.test:web:smoke:list: env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR npm run test:smoke:list --workspace @jambandnerd/web
scripts.verify:python: uv run black --check src tests scripts && uv run ruff check src tests scripts && uv run pytest --collect-only -q && uv run pytest --cov=src --cov-report=term-missing --cov-fail-under=50
scripts.verify:docs: NO_MKDOCS_2_WARNING=true uv run --with mkdocs --with mkdocs-material --with pymdown-extensions mkdocs build --strict
scripts.verify:web: npm run test:web:smoke:list && npm run lint:web && npm run build:web && npm run test:web:smoke
scripts.verify:types: uv run mypy src tests scripts
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify:python && npm run verify:docs && npm run verify:web
